props.text: Quiet on bounties/oracles today, but the agent-payments chain race flipped again and a stablecoin-settlement neobank crossed $1B — two verifiable moves, nothing else cleared the bar.

props.title: Base Retakes x402 Lead as Weekly Agent Payments Hit 8.7M Transfers

props.text: Token Terminal data (via Cryptonomist) shows the week of Aug 17 was the busiest of the year for onchain agent-to-agent activity — 8.7M stablecoin transfers, more than double the prior week. Base reclaimed the top chain spot at 4.2M transfers (48% share, $191,816), edging out Solana's 3.3M (38%, $91,715) — a reversal of the Solana-led split reported two days ago.
Why it matters: chain dominance for x402 volume is still swinging week to week — don't assume last week's leader holds when picking a settlement chain for agent payments.

props.title: Stablecoin Neobank Fasset Hits $1B Valuation on $68M SBI-Led Round

props.text: Fasset closed a $68M Series C led by Japan's SBI Group, crossing a $1B valuation to scale agentic AI systems for corridor banking and stablecoin settlement. The platform already processes $40B+ in annualized volume across 3M+ wallets in 125 countries via its Own Network L2 (Arbitrum-based), and plans to deepen agentic-AI investment with the new capital.
Why it matters: real capital betting that agent-driven settlement infrastructure — not the agents themselves — is where value accrues in this cycle.

Thin day: X signal (7 posts, Aug 25 window) was entirely low-engagement token-promo (BAI_AGI/TRON campaign posts, self-promo for an unrelated x402 side-project) — no verifiable claims. No AI-judged-bounty or oracle-dispute news surfaced; several candidates (Superteam Earn's agent API, GenLayer Internet Court) were previously-covered or undated on inspection.
